A '''tool harness''' was a piece of support clothing that allowed an individual to carry tools about their person. They were readily available for sale throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and generally cost ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase.<ref name="SWS" />
